method: 13 deterministic pytest tests on the REAL P1 SQLite repository through the isolated stage harness; zero provider calls; specialist results are SYNTHETIC_SPECIALIST_RESULTs driven through the REAL executor/registry/completion transaction

tests.name: test_parity_also_holds_on_no_evidence_fixture
tests.asserts: Path B model-visible input byte-identical to Path A production capture on the no-evidence fixture; empty evidence contract legal (no fabricated keys)

tests.name: test_integration_input_parity_path_a_vs_path_b
tests.asserts: full §6 field matrix equal; D-handles for fresh results and E-handles for real bound evidence present; IsolatedIntegrationInputV1 validates

tests.name: test_t1_valid_integration_decision_commits
tests.asserts: production chain in order (model_output_received -> pydantic_validation -> canonical_resolution -> decision_validator -> transition_validation -> integration_commit); revision +1; delegation integrated exactly as the normal path; stage created no run; finalization NOT_EXERCISED

tests.name: test_t2_invalid_union_fails_closed_observable
tests.asserts: UNKNOWN discriminant -> pydantic FAIL, retry mechanism identical to production (retry_attempts=1 recorded), ONE diagnostics entry for the ONE failed payload, no commit, state unchanged

tests.name: test_t3_extra_forbidden_field_rejected_and_sanitized
tests.asserts: server-owned field (tool_call_count) -> extra_forbidden with field location recorded; offending input VALUE never recorded (details carry type+loc only)

tests.name: test_t4_invalid_enum_rejected_within_frozen_retry_budget
tests.asserts: invalid enum -> literal_error; exactly 2 model invocations (initial + 1 in-band retry, the frozen budget); no auto-correction, no commit

tests.name: test_t5_handle_layers_each_own_their_validation
tests.asserts: pattern-valid unknown handle -> resolver HANDLE_UNKNOWN fail-closed; wrong-kind handle -> schema pattern rejection first; binding table hash immutable (no evidence identity drift)

tests.name: test_t6_stale_inputs_refused
tests.asserts: revision moved after context freeze -> commit refuses (no partial state); tampered source result hash -> commit revalidation refuses (delegation stays unintegrated)

tests.name: test_t7_mixed_actions_all_or_nothing
tests.asserts: legal + illegal action in one proposal -> WHOLE proposal rejected; no partial commit; evidence snapshot payload/captured_at unchanged

tests.name: test_t8_provider_failures_classified_not_schema
tests.asserts: APITimeoutError -> provider_request_timeout; APIConnectionError -> provider_connection_error; neither misreported as model_output_*; contained, no commit

tests.name: test_t9_diagnostic_sink_on_harness_path
tests.asserts: 0600 JSONL sink on the REAL harness path: stage=SUPERVISOR_INTEGRATE, run_id matches the test AgentRun, schema_hash matches production V2, tool_name=final_result, retry_attempts=1, validation_error_details observable

tests.name: test_t10_stage_lifecycle_ownership
tests.asserts: no non-terminal AgentRun after the stage; bound run stays terminal; finalization explicitly NOT_EXERCISED; agent_run_created=false; specialist result byte-identical (no re-execution)

tests.name: test_stage_input_contract_rejects_incomplete
tests.asserts: IsolatedIntegrationInputV1 validator rejects missing required fields

suite_result: 2644 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed (full python_service unit suite; 2631 baseline + 13 new; zero regressions)
